This is a coolant manifold assembly (a thermal management module) for an electric vehicle drivetrain, with channels for coolant circulation and mounting points for a pump and valve. It is a part of a motor vehicle, so Chapter 87 is the starting point.

Several candidate headings exist:
- 8708.99 covers other parts and accessories of motor vehicles.
- 8708.91 covers radiators, but this assembly is not a radiator.
- 8419.50 covers heat exchangers.
- 8421.99 covers parts of filtering machinery.
- 8409.99 covers engine parts, but the description says it serves a battery and motor drivetrain, so that is unlikely.
- 8473 and 8708.99 remain as general alternatives.

The description is similar to CBP rulings on EV thermal management coolant manifolds, which I recall were classified in 8708.99.8180 (other parts and accessories, other). The description's reference to an engine of a motor vehicle fits this. I am going from memory of those rulings and have not verified one.

The 8708.99 subheadings are:
- 8708.99.81, other: 8708.99.8180 (other)
- 8708.99.68, other

I am choosing 8708.99.8180.

{"hts_code": "8708.99.8180", "reason": "The coolant manifold assembly is a part of a motor vehicle's thermal management system and is not specifically provided for elsewhere, so it falls in the residual 'other parts and accessories of motor vehicles' provision of heading 8708."}
